component.name: AmbientView
component.script:
sub init() try m.a = m.top.findNode("a") m.b = m.top.findNode("b") m.a.scaleRotateCenter = [960, 540] m.b.scaleRotateCenter = [960, 540] m.title = m.top.findNode("title") m.sub = m.top.findNode("sub") m.clock = m.top.findNode("clock") m.fadeIn = m.top.findNode("fadeIn") m.driftA = m.top.findNode("driftA") m.driftB = m.top.findNode("driftB") m.timer = m.top.findNode("timer") m.timer.observeField("fire", "nextImage") m.clockTimer = m.top.findNode("clockTimer") m.clockTimer.observeField("fire", "updateClock") m.items = collect() m.i = -1 m.front = m.a updateClock() nextImage() m.timer.control = "start" m.clockTimer.control = "start" catch e reportCrash("HfScreensaver.init", e) end try end sub
' Junta títulos com imagem de fundo: «Continuar a ver», biblioteca e catálogos guardados do Início function collect() as object out = [] seen = {} src = [] src.Append(continueRowItems()) src.Append(libraryRowItems()) raw = ReadAsciiFile("cachefs:/home_rows.json") if raw <> "" rows = ParseJson(raw) if rows <> invalid and type(rows) = "roArray" for each r in rows if r.items <> invalid and type(r.items) = "roArray" then src.Append(r.items) end for end if end if for each x in src id = strOr(x.id) if Left(id, 2) = "tt" id = id.Split(":")[0] if not seen.DoesExist(id) and out.Count() < 80 seen[id] = true out.Push({ id: id, bg: "https://images.metahub.space/background/large/" + id + "/img", name: strOr(x.name), kind: strOr(x.type) }) end if end if end for ' baralhar for i = out.Count() - 1 to 1 step -1 j = Rnd(i + 1) - 1 t = out[i] out[i] = out[j] out[j] = t end for return out end function
sub nextImage() try if m.items.Count() = 0 m.title.text = "Hortêncioflix" m.sub.text = "" return end if m.i = (m.i + 1) mod m.items.Count() it = m.items[m.i] ' a imagem nova entra por cima da anterior, com fade, e começa o seu movimento lento old = m.front if m.front.isSameNode(m.a) m.front = m.b drift = m.driftB else m.front = m.a drift = m.driftA end if m.front.opacity = 0 m.front.uri = it.bg ' transição cruzada: a nova aparece enquanto a anterior desaparece m.fadeIn.control = "stop" m.fadeIn.getChild(0).fieldToInterp = m.front.id + ".opacity" m.fadeIn.getChild(1).fieldToInterp = old.id + ".opacity" m.fadeIn.control = "start" drift.control = "stop" drift.control = "start" m.title.text = it.name k = "Filme" if it.kind = "series" then k = "Série" m.sub.text = k catch e reportCrash("HfScreensaver.nextImage", e) end try end sub
sub onInteractive() m.top.findNode("hint").visible = m.top.interactive end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press or not m.top.interactive then return false if key = "OK" or key = "play" if m.items.Count() > 0 and m.i >= 0 it = m.items[m.i] m.top.chosen = { id: it.id, type: it.kind, name: it.name } return true end if end if if key = "right" and m.items.Count() > 0 m.timer.control = "stop" nextImage() m.timer.control = "start" return true end if m.top.dismiss = true return true end function
sub updateClock() dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") dt.ToLocalTime() h = dt.GetHours() mi = dt.GetMinutes() hs = h.ToStr() ms = mi.ToStr() if mi < 10 then ms = "0" + ms m.clock.text = hs + ":" + ms end sub
